title: NVIDIA fiscal 2027 second-quarter results
excerpt: Revenue was $96.221 billion and Data Center revenue was $89.023 billion; fiscal Q3 revenue guidance was $108.0 billion plus or minus 2%.
summary: The release shows 18% sequential and 106% annual revenue growth, a 75.0% GAAP gross margin, continued Blackwell demand, a Rubin production ramp and guidance that assumes no China Data Center compute revenue.
